name: No bar (Caelestia mode)
author: Jarvis WorkOS
description: An empty full-bar option: selected by `jarvis-shell-mode caelestia` while Caelestia draws the bar, so Omarchy's shell keeps running its menu, clipboard, polkit agent and other services without a second bar. `omarchy bar reset` (or `jarvis-shell-mode omarchy`) brings Omarchy's bar back.
